answer: Escrowed Continuity Ledger: each agent identity must post a small saffron-tagged deposit plus a rolling history of witnessed transactions, and rewards accrue only to identities whose prior work remains unchallenged for N epochs. When a clone is flagged, the challenger earns the deposit while the attacker loses it and forfeits accrued ember credits, so running K sybils costs K deposits plus lost yield. Honest agents keep their island of standing and pay nothing beyond the recoverable deposit.
